<?php

class ChildClean104D { function __destruct() { global $stop, $weakRetval, $weakChild; echo 'CHILD|', $weakRetval->get() === null, '|', $weakChild->get() === $this, '|'; throw $stop; } }
class RetvalClean104D {
    public $child;

        global $source, $weakSource, $weakOld, $weakMaker, $weakPrefix, $weakPending, $weakCapture, $weakRetval, $weakChild;
        echo 'RETVAL|', $weakSource->get() instanceof Closure, '|', $weakOld->get() instanceof OldClean104D, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof MakerClean104D, '|', $weakPrefix->get() instanceof PrefixClean104D, '|', $weakPending->get() instanceof PendingClean104D, '|', $weakCapture->get() instanceof CaptureClean104D, '|', $weakChild->get() === $this->child, '|', $weakRetval->get() === $this, '|';
        $source = null; exit(41);
    }
}
class OldClean104D {
    function make($capture) { return function (&$first, &$second) use ($capture) { echo 'BAD-BODY|'; try { yield $capture; } finally { echo 'BAD-GEN-FIN|'; } }; }
    function __destruct() { echo 'OLD|'; }
}
class MakerClean104D { function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; } }
function NewMaker104D() { global $weakMaker; $value = new MakerClean104D(); $weakMaker = WeakReference::create($value); return $value; }
function NewPrefix104D() { global $weakPrefix; $value = new PrefixClean104D(); $weakPrefix = WeakReference::create($value); return $value; }
function NewPending104D() { global $weakPending; $value = new PendingClean104D(); $weakPending = WeakReference::create($value); return $value; }
function NewRetval104D() {
    global $weakRetval, $weakChild;
    $child = new ChildClean104D(); $weakChild = WeakReference::create($child);

function Quiet104D($severity, $message) { echo 'BAD-HANDLER|'; return true; }

}
function Shutdown104D() {

$capture = new CaptureClean104D(); $weakCapture = WeakReference::create($capture);
$old = new OldClean104D(); $weakOld = WeakReference::create($old);
$source = $old->make($capture); $weakSource = WeakReference::create($source); unset($old, $capture);
$generator = null; $warnings = 0; set_error_handler('Warn104D'); register_shutdown_function('Shutdown104D');

    echo 'CAUGHT|', $caught === $stop, '|'; unset($caught, $stop);
    $previous = set_error_handler('Quiet104D');
    echo 'OBS|', $weakSource->get() === null, '|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|', $weakPrefix->get() === null, '|', $weakPending->get() === null, '|', $weakRetval->get() === null, '|', $weakChild->get() === null, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof MakerClean104D, '|', $weakCapture->get() instanceof CaptureClean104D, '|', $warnings === 2, '|', $previous === 'Warn104D', '|', $generator === null, '|', $weakStop->get() === null, '|';
    restore_error_handler();
